input.overview: Lock two balls in the Grotto, then shoot either ramp to release them and start three-ball Multiball. Every ramp shot during Multiball awards a Jackpot and advances P-I-N-B-A-L-L; completing that word lights Extra Ball at the spinner. Outside Multiball, repeated ramps spell M-A-N-S-I-O-N and begin a falling-value Mansion collect.
input.simpleOverview: Lock two balls in the Grotto, then shoot either ramp for three-ball Multiball. During Multiball, every ramp scores a Jackpot and advances P-I-N-B-A-L-L; finish the word to light Extra Ball at the spinner. Repeated ramps also spell M-A-N-S-I-O-N for a timed value on the next ramp.
input.summary: Lock two balls in the Grotto, then shoot either ramp for three-ball Multiball. Every Multiball ramp scores a Jackpot and advances P-I-N-B-A-L-L. Spell M-A-N-S-I-O-N outside Multiball, then shoot a ramp for its falling value.

steps.text: Shoot two balls into the Grotto to fill both locks.
With both balls locked, shoot either ramp to release them and start three-ball Multiball.
During Multiball, repeat either ramp for Jackpots and one P-I-N-B-A-L-L letter per shot.
Complete P-I-N-B-A-L-L to light Extra Ball at the spinner.

alternatives.title: Build playfield scoring
alternatives.when: Use this before Multiball when the animal targets are available.

steps.text: Complete the animal targets to start the timed playfield multiplier.
Continue completing the bank to raise the timed multiplier, then attack ramps and the Grotto while it is active.
When the Mansion countdown begins, return to either ramp before the displayed value falls.
Use H-M-H top-lane completions to raise bonus up to 5x and eventually light Extra Ball at the spinner.

machineSetup: Confirm extra-ball, playfield-multiplier duration, and Jackpot settings before competitive play.
Test both Grotto locks, both ramps and releases, animal targets, H-M-H lanes, spinner, and PLAYBOY targets.

cautions.response: Finish the animal bank only when you can immediately attack ramps, locks, or another high-value repeat shot.
